label: Request a quote
headline:
Tell us what
you're building
text: Every request is read by the person who will design it. Send whatever you have — a rough idea, a reference, or a bike that needs to look fast parked.

steps.title: You send the brief
steps.text: Photos, the bike, the number and any sponsors you need on it.

steps.title: We price it
steps.text: A fixed quote back within one working day — no hourly surprises.

steps.title: Proof, then print
steps.text: You approve the artwork on your own bike before we cut a single decal.

form.briefPlaceholder: Colours, number, sponsors, the look you're after — the more the better.
form.photosTooLarge: Those photos are too large to send together (8 MB max). Try fewer or smaller photos.
form.note: No obligation · fixed price back in one working day
form.errorMessage: That didn't go through. Try again, or send the details straight to the studio email.

success.title: Request received
success.message: Thanks {name}. We'll look over the details and come back with a fixed price, usually within one working day.
